review_candidates.title: SSE Performance Steering Head
review_candidates.description: Company Description Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed. Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere. Job Description More about our mission and what we offer . Your Mission Wise is scaling at an incredible pace, moving over £9 billion a month for 15 million customers. To keep our mission of "money without borders" sustainable, we must ensure our global operations are not just growing, but evolving. As the Global Head of Performance Steering, your mission is to lead a high-impact team of Performance Steering Leads (PSLs) across three continents. You will architect the data-driven frameworks that allow Wise to maximize capacity, reduce operational variance, and bridge the gap between technical product capabilities and manual operational effort. You are the guardian of operational efficiency, ensuring that as we scale, our performance remains predictable, high-quality, and cost-effective. The Role You will lead a global team of Performance Steering Leads based in India, Estonia, and the US. Your role is to elevate the "Performance Steering" function from individual metric monitoring to a cohesive global strategy. You will be responsible for the collective output of your leads, ensuring they effectively govern KPI targets and drive remediation across Customer Support, KYC, FinCrime, and Payment Operations. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Strategy: Manage and mentor a global team of PSLs, setting the long-term vision for metric governance and efficiency reviews. Global KPI Governance: Oversee the setting of aggressive yet achievable targets for core metrics (AHT, Occupancy, Adherence, CpH, SLA) across all global service teams and vendor partners. Advanced Statistical Oversight: Ensure the team effectively utilizes methodologies like Variance Significance Factor (VSF) and standard deviation analysis to eliminate operational performance gaps. Strategic Remediation: Act as the final point of escalation for complex Root Cause Analyses (RCAs). You will ensure that performance "triggers" lead to immediate, measurable action plans rather than just passive reporting. Product-Ops Integration: Partner with Product and Engineering leads to translate operational performance data into product requirements. You will identify where manual bottlenecks (Operational Debt) can be solved through automation. Vendor Governance: Work with Vendor Management to implement global scorecards and frameworks that ensure our external partners meet the same high-efficiency standards as our internal teams. Qualifications A bit about you You are a "builder" who thrives in non-corporate, fast-moving environments. You have a deep understanding of how large-scale operations function and a passion for using data to solve human and process-driven problems. Must-Haves Proven Leadership: 7+ years of experience in high-growth operations, with a track record of leading teams of leads or senior individual contributors. Analytical Power: Expert-level proficiency in SQL and data visualization. You must be comfortable interpreting complex statistical control metrics to assess process stability. WFM Mastery: A deep "under the hood" understanding of Workforce Management (WFM) and efficiency metrics. Storytelling with Data: Ability to take complex operational data and turn it into a compelling narrative for senior stakeholders, influencing roadmaps without direct authority. The "Wise" Mindset: You are entrepreneurial, hands-on, and ready to challenge conventional approaches or risk-averse mentalities. Nice-to-Haves Experience with Python or advanced automation tools (e.g., Twilio). A background in FinCrime or KYC operations within a high-growth FinTech environment. Experience managing "dotted line" relationships across global sites. Additional Information For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive. We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences. Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers. If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs. Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Reporting & Analysis - Produce structured shift handoff reports, prepare daily/weekly on-call summaries, and surface recurring trends to L3. Escalation - Escalate infrastructure-level issues to Tree Hugger (L2) with full context: timeline, logs reviewed, classification, and actions taken.

review_candidates.title: OPERATIONS MANAGER – RESIDENTIAL COMPOUNDS
review_candidates.description: Al Amari Group is seeking a highly experienced, structured, and hands-on Operations Manager to lead and control the day-to-day operations and service performance across our portfolio of residential compounds. This is a multi-site management role requiring full operational oversight across multiple residential communities — not the management of a single property or facility. The successful candidate will be responsible for assessing the operational requirements of each compound, developing a tailored Operating Plan for every location , and implementing all plans under one unified operational framework, service standard, and performance management system across the Group. The objective is to ensure that every residential community is consistently well-managed, clean, secure, properly maintained, responsive to residents, and operating according to clearly defined service standards. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Take full administrative and operational oversight of multiple residential compounds simultaneously . Assess each compound individually based on its size, occupancy, facilities, staffing, resident needs, service requirements, and operational challenges. Develop and implement a comprehensive Operating Plan for each compound , covering manpower, service schedules, responsibilities, inspections, reporting, escalation, and performance requirements. Establish a unified operational framework across all compounds while maintaining location-specific plans according to the requirements of each community. Develop and enforce SOPs, SLAs, KPIs, service standards, checklists, inspection schedules, escalation matrices, and reporting procedures . Oversee the administrative performance and service delivery of cleaning, security, maintenance coordination, landscaping, common areas, parking, swimming pools, gyms, reception, and other shared facilities . Define clear responsibilities and accountability for Compound Managers, Supervisors, service teams, and external service providers. Establish daily, weekly, and monthly operational schedules and ensure consistent execution across all locations. Conduct and manage structured inspections to proactively identify service deficiencies before they develop into resident complaints. Ensure all maintenance and operational issues are logged, prioritized, assigned, tracked, escalated when necessary, and verified before closure . Establish and control a structured resident complaint and service-request management process , including response times, ownership, escalation levels, and closure standards. Analyze recurring complaints and operational failures, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive action plans . Monitor manpower utilization across compounds and recommend staffing redistribution or additional resources based on actual operational requirements and workload. Monitor the performance of internal teams and service providers against defined KPIs and SLAs , and take corrective action when performance falls below standard. Coordinate operational requirements with Maintenance, Engineering, Procurement, HR, Finance, and other relevant departments . Monitor operational costs and identify opportunities to improve efficiency without compromising service quality or resident experience . Establish clear operational dashboards and management reports covering open issues, complaint status, SLA compliance, inspections, maintenance coordination, staffing, service-provider performance, recurring issues, and corrective actions . Provide the General Manager with structured weekly and monthly operational performance reports , risks, priorities, and recommended actions. Continuously improve operational systems to ensure consistent and sustainable service quality across the entire residential portfolio. KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS Performance will be measured through: Service quality across all compounds Resident complaint response and closure SLA compliance Cleaning and security standards Preventive and corrective maintenance coordination Inspection compliance and issue closure Recurring problem reduction Staff and service-provider performance Operational cost control Resident satisfaction Consistency of standards across all locations REQUIREMENTS Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Operations Management, Property Management, Community Management, Residential Compound Operations, or Facilities Operations. Minimum 3 years in a managerial position with direct responsibility for multiple sites, properties, residential communities, or compounds simultaneously. Proven Multi-Site Management experience is essential. Candidates whose management experience is limited primarily to a single building, property, or site will not meet the core requirements of this position. Proven experience developing and implementing site-specific operating plans within a standardized multi-site operational framework . Strong experience managing multiple service functions including cleaning, security, maintenance coordination, landscaping, common facilities, and resident services . Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, SLAs, KPIs, checklists, inspection systems, escalation procedures, and operational dashboards . Strong experience in resident complaint management, service recovery, escalation, and problem resolution . Demonstrated ability to manage multiple teams, priorities, service providers, and operational issues across different locations. Strong administrative leadership with the ability to establish accountability and enforce service standards. Strong planning, analytical, reporting, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. Strong understanding of service quality, community operations, and resident experience within professionally managed residential developments. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Facility Management, or a related field . Excellent Arabic and English communication skills. THE PROFILE WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are not looking for someone who simply reacts to daily operational problems . We are looking for an Operations Manager who can: Assess multiple compounds. Build a tailored operating plan for each one. Create one unified operational system. Set measurable service standards. Assign clear accountability. Monitor execution. Identify gaps before residents do. Solve recurring problems at the root cause. And maintain consistent service quality across the entire portfolio. Proven multi-site operational leadership is a core requirement for this position.
